title: Cranes - Information to be provided, Part 5: Overhead travelling cranes and portal bridge cranes
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 9374 specifies information to be provided a) by a purchaser in enquiring about or ordering an overhead travelling crane or portal bridge crane; and b) by a nnanufacturer in tendering for or supplying an overhead travelling crane or portal bridge crane. suitable overhead travelling crane or portal bridge crane and equipment to satisfy the duty requirements and service conditions. 4 Information to be provided by the manufacturer
clause_3_terminology: Part 5: Overhead travelling cranes and portal bridge cranes

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
